checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Plant Watering Tracker", the text "No plants yet", and the tab labelled "Log" is present.

Filling the field labelled "Plant name" with "Fern" and the field labelled "Interval (days)" with "3", then clicking the button "Add plant" adds a list item containing "Fern" and "every 3 days"; the text "No plants yet" is gone.
With the plant "Fern" present, clicking the button "Water Fern" adds a log entry and the list item for Fern shows "Last watered: today" and "Streak: 1".
After clicking "Water Fern" once, switching to the tab labelled "Log" shows a table row containing "Fern" and the text "1"; the heatmap in the Log tab shows a single filled cell.
With the plant "Fern" present, clicking the button "Delete Fern" removes the list item and the text "No plants yet" reappears.
Filling the field labelled "Plant name" with "Cactus" and the field labelled "Interval (days)" with "7", then clicking "Add plant", adds a list item containing "Cactus" and "every 7 days".

With the plant "Fern" (interval 3) present, clicking the button "Advance day" three times changes the Fern list item to show "Due in: 0 days" and triggers the in-app alert banner with the text "Fern is due for water".
With the plant "Fern" present, clicking the button "Export log" shows the toast "Log copied to clipboard" and the clipboard contains a line starting with "Fern,".
Reload keeps the plant "Fern" with the text "every 3 days" and the log entry showing "Streak: 1".
